claims.claim: GeoBoN is fixed-budget Best-of-N rollout selection using minimum frozen-VGGT-Omega cross-view depth reprojection inconsistency.
Gated GeoBoN first applies an action-future agreement gate and samples extra candidates only when the initial rollout is inconsistent.
At fixed N=8 all five headline benchmark-backbone settings improve, but category-level X-WAM Door/Drawer falls from 96.7 to 92.1.
At Nmax=8, averages derived from the five Table 2 settings are 74.8% full-gain recovery and 26.2% trigger rate.
Offline error recovery is a selector proxy, not an online-success equivalent.
False low-score selection rises 7%,10%,12%,32% as N=2,4,8,16.
GeoBoN exceeds the Cosmos Policy value head under matched candidate budgets.
